significance: A Bhadrakali temple beside Vellayani Lake south of Thiruvananthapuram, known for the Kaliyoottu Mahotsavam held once every three years, a festival of some sixty-five to seventy days said to be the longest continuous temple festival in south India.
story: A blacksmith named Kelan Kulasekhara is said to have found a divine frog near Vellayani Lake and consecrated an image in which the goddess took her seat.
